MIUI stops background apps unless auto-start is enabled. This keeps dealer commands and device protection working.

1. Tap "Open Auto-start Settings"
2. Find IBS Config App in the list
3. Turn ON auto-start for IBS Config App
4. Return here and confirm
ColorOS blocks background services unless startup is allowed for this app.

1. Tap "Open Auto-start Settings"
2. Open Startup manager / Auto-launch apps
3. Enable IBS Config App
4. Return here and confirm
Realme UI requires auto-start permission so the protection service stays running.

1. Tap "Open Auto-start Settings"
2. Find IBS Config App
3. Allow auto-start / run in background
4. Return here and confirm
Vivo phones stop background apps unless background startup is allowed.

1. Tap "Open Auto-start Settings"
2. Open Background startup / Auto-start manager
3. Enable IBS Config App
4. Return here and confirm
One UI may stop background services to save battery. Allow unrestricted background use for IBS Config App.

1. Tap "Disable Battery Optimization"
2. Choose Allow / Don't optimize for IBS Config App
3. In Device care, set app battery to Unrestricted if prompted
4. Return here and confirm
EMUI closes background apps unless they are protected and allowed to auto-launch.

1. Tap "Open Protected Apps Settings"
2. Add IBS Config App to Protected apps
3. Enable auto-launch / run in background if shown
4. Return here and confirm
Your phone may stop background services. Disable battery optimization so dealer commands reach this device.

1. Tap "Disable Battery Optimization"
2. Allow unrestricted background activity
3. If your phone has auto-start settings, enable them for IBS Config App
4. Return here and confirm
